0022600146.text: The Memphis Grizzlies come in at 3-0 on a three-game winning streak, with a 2-0 road record and a spot 0.5 games back in 2nd in the Southwest, while the Portland Trail Blazers are 2-0 and 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 122-114 Portland win in Memphis on March 4, 2026. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood, who is out with ankle soreness, and Shaedon Sharpe, who is out following knee surgery.
